about: Input schemas of the Replicate endpoints Fuobe's live hosted routes call, read from the provider's public pages by scripts/refresh-live-route-schemas.mjs. tests/provider-conformance-live-routes.test.ts checks the requests Fuobe builds against them.

mask_url.description: URL of the mask video file defining the area to erase

auto_trim.description: If true, videos longer than 5 seconds are trimmed to the first 5 seconds. If false, videos over 5 seconds will be rejected.

preserve_audio.description: Whether to maintain original audio in output

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible outputs. Set to -1 to use a non-deterministic seed.

audio.description: Audio or video file to transcribe. Supports MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, WebM, AAC, MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, and more. Max 3 GB, up to 10 hours.

diarize.description: Identify and label different speakers in the audio. When enabled, each word in the output includes a 'speaker_id'. Supports up to 32 speakers.

keyterms.description: Comma-separated list of words or phrases to bias transcription towards. Useful for product names, technical terms, or proper nouns. Up to 1000 terms, max 50 characters each.

no_verbatim.description: Remove filler words ('um', 'uh'), false starts, and disfluencies from the transcript. Produces a cleaner, more readable output.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Higher values produce more diverse, less deterministic output. Set to -1 to use the model default (usually 0).

num_speakers.description: Maximum number of speakers expected in the audio. Helps the model with diarization. Set to 0 to let the model decide. Only used when 'diarize' is true.

language_code.description: Language of the audio as an ISO-639-1 (e.g. 'en') or ISO-639-3 (e.g. 'eng') code. Set to 'auto' to detect the language automatically. Setting a specific language can improve accuracy for noisy or unusual audio.

tag_audio_events.description: Tag non-speech sounds in the transcription, like (laughter), (footsteps), or (applause).

timestamps_granularity.description: Granularity of word timestamps in the output. 'word' returns start/end times for each word, 'character' adds per-character timing, 'none' omits timestamps.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

safety_filter_level.description: block_low_and_above is strictest, block_medium_and_above blocks some prompts, block_only_high is most permissive but some prompts will still be blocked

seed.description:
Random seed for generation. Set to a specific value for more "
            "reproducible results, though exact determinism is not guaranteed.

images.description: Input images to inspire the music composition (up to 10 images)

prompt.description:
Text prompt describing the music to generate. Be specific "
            "about genre, instruments, mood, tempo, and style for best results.

seed.description:
Random seed for generation. Set to a specific value for more "
            "reproducible results, though exact determinism is not guaranteed.

images.description: Input images to inspire the music composition (up to 10 images)

prompt.description:
Text prompt describing the song to generate. Include details "
            "like genre, instruments, mood, tempo, lyrics, and song structure "
            "(e.g. [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge]) for best results. You can also "
            "use timestamps like [0:00 - 0:30] to control timing.
A text description of the image you want to generate

image_input.description: Input images to transform or use as reference (supports multiple images)

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

prompt.description: A text description of the image you want to generate

image_input.description: Input images to transform or use as reference (supports up to 14 images)

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

safety_filter_level.description: block_low_and_above is strictest, block_medium_and_above blocks some prompts, block_only_high is most permissive but some prompts will still be blocked

allow_fallback_model.description: Fallback to another model (currently bytedance/seedream-5) if Nano Banana Pro is at capacity.

seed.description: Random seed. Omit for random generations

image.description: Input image to start generating from. Ideal images are 16:9 or 9:16 and 1280x720 or 720x1280, depending on the aspect ratio you choose.

last_frame.description: Ending image for interpolation. When provided with an input image, creates a transition between the two images.

negative_prompt.description: Description of what to exclude from the generated video

reference_images.description: 1 to 3 reference images for subject-consistent generation (reference-to-video, or R2V). Reference images only work with 16:9 aspect ratio and 8-second duration. Last frame is ignored if reference images are provided.

seed.description: Random seed. Reusing a seed does not guarantee identical results, because the prompt is expanded before generation.

images.description: Up to 8 input images to edit or combine. Leave empty for text-to-image generation. When using several images, refer to each by what it shows in the prompt.

prompt.description: Instruction describing the image to generate, or the edit to make. For edits, say what should change and what should stay the same.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output. 'auto' picks the framing from your input images and prompt.

regional_edit.description: Experimental. Change only the parts of the image that need to change and keep the rest unchanged. Needs at least one input image. Quality may be lower and generation slower than a regular edit.

thinking_mode.description: How much planning happens before generation. 'fast' is quicker and works for most requests. 'high' plans complex or multi-step edits more carefully, but is slower and costs more.

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the output.

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the video. Ignored if start_image is provided.

guidance_scale.description: Kept for backwards compatibility. This parameter is not used.

negative_prompt.description: Things you do not want to see in the video

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video. Refer to images as @image_1, @image_2, ... and videos as @video_1, @video_2, ... (see start_image and reference_images for numbering). Up to 26,000 English characters or 11,000 non-English characters.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Ignored when base_video is set.

end_image.description: Last frame of the video. Same format requirements as start_image.

base_video.description: Video to edit (.mp4/.mov, 3-30 seconds, 700-4553px per side, max 300MB). Referred to as @video_1. When set, the output keeps the length and aspect ratio of this video.

start_image.description: First frame of the video. Supports .jpg/.jpeg/.png, max 30MB, min 300px, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output video. Ignored when start_image, middle_images, end_image or base_video is set, since the aspect ratio then comes from the input.

middle_images.description: Keyframes between the first and last frame, in order. Same format requirements as start_image.

reference_images.description: Reference images for characters, objects, scenes or style. Images are numbered in this order: start_image, middle_images, end_image, reference_images. Up to 10 images in total across all image inputs.

reference_videos.description: Reference videos to take motion, camera work or style from (.mp4/.mov, 3-30 seconds each, 700-4553px per side, max 300MB). Numbered after base_video.

seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation

image.description: Image to use for the first frame of the video. If provided, the video is generated from this image.

prompt.description: Text prompt for video generation. Supports detailed, multi-shot prompts up to 5000 characters for text-to-video, 2048 for image-to-video.

quality.description: Resolution of the video. Higher resolutions cost more. See pricing for details.

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds. Billing is per second.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the video. Only used for text-to-video. Ignored when image is provided.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to avoid certain elements in the video

generate_audio_switch.description: Enable AI-generated audio including background music, sound effects, and character dialogue

generate_multi_clip_switch.description: Enable multi-shot generation for cinematic sequences with scene transitions

audio.description: Speech audio, up to 3 minutes; the video matches its length. Overrides voice_script.

image.description: Portrait of the person who speaks (first frame). Supports jpg, jpeg, png, webp.

resolution.description: Video resolution. 1080p, 2k and 4k generate at 768p and upscale it (24 fps kept); 4k is limited to 125 s of audio.

voice_prompt.description: Delivery instructions for the TTS voice (tone, pacing, accent, emotion). Not spoken.

voice_script.description: Exact words to speak with Gemini TTS. Required when no audio is uploaded.

prompt_upsampling.description: Let a vision model look at the image and append the scene's own motion (rain, lights, background, body movement) to your prompt. Your words stay unchanged and come first.

enable_safety_filter.description: Block content in the toggleable moderation categories. The always-on rules apply either way.

mode.description: speed runs on 4x B200; cost runs the same model on one B200 (slower, cheaper).

audio.description: Reference audio files to condition the generation on. Set keep_audio to use a single file as the video's audio.

image.description: Reference images to condition the generation on.

video.description: Reference videos to condition the generation on.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. With keep_audio, an audio file within 1 s of it sets the length instead.

keep_audio.description: Keep the uploaded audio as the video's audio instead of only using it as a reference. Needs exactly one audio file. The video is generated to match it. If the audio is shorter than duration, the video plays it first and the model generates the rest. If it is longer, it is cut to duration. If it is within 1 s of duration, the video's length follows the audio's.

resolution.description: Video resolution. 1080p, 2k and 4k generate at 768p and upscale it (24 fps kept).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. adaptive uses the most common one among the reference images and videos.

last_frame_image.description: Optional image the video should end on. Combines with the other references.

prompt_upsampler.description: Rewrite the prompt into a detailed H3 brief that looks at the references first: turbo (our upsampler), max (MiniMax; falls back to turbo), or off. With adaptive aspect ratio, turbo also picks the ratio.

first_frame_image.description: Optional image the video should open on. Combines with the other references. Needs prompt upsampling, so prompt_upsampler=off runs turbo when a start or end frame is given.

enable_safety_filter.description: Check the inputs against the content policy. When off, only the always-on categories (sexual content involving minors, self-harm intent or instructions) are still blocked.

seed.description: Random seed. Leave blank for random.

turbo.description: Turbo mode: faster generation for slightly lower quality.

video.description: Source RGB video (.mp4): motion + audio source.

images.description: Identity reference image(s) (1-3) to place into the video.

resolution.description: Target ~megapixel budget: 720p ≈ 1 MP, 1080p ≈ 2 MP (aspect ratio preserved).

target_fps.description: Target FPS for the working video.

ignore_audio.description: Ignore source audio during generation. If save_audio is true, the source audio is still saved with the final video.

instruction_prompt.description: Further instruction on how to place the people from the reference images into the scene.

disable_safety_checker.description: Disable safety checker for generated videos.

seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation

lora_scales.description: Scales for each LoRA as an array of floats. Must match the number of lora_weights. Defaults to 1.0 for each if not provided.

lora_weights.description: LoRA weights as an array of URLs. Supports .safetensors URLs, tar files, and zip files (e.g., ['https://example.com/lora1.safetensors', 'https://example.com/lora2.safetensors'])

guidance_scale.description: Guidance scale. Should be 0 for Turbo models

output_quality.description: Quality when saving the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality. Not relevant for .png outputs

num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps. This actually results in (num_inference_steps - 1) DiT forwards

seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation.

image.description: Images to use as reference. Must be jpeg, png, gif, or webp.

prompt.description: Text instruction on how to edit the given image.

go_fast.description: Run faster predictions with additional optimizations.

lora_scale.description: Strength applied to the selected LoRA.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the generated image.

lora_weights.description: LoRA weights to apply. Pass a Hugging Face repo slug (for example 'owner/model') or a direct .safetensors URL. Leave blank to run without a LoRA.

output_quality.description: Quality when saving the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality. Not relevant for .png outputs.

disable_safety_checker.description: Disable safety checker for generated images.

seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation.

image.description: Image to be converted into a layered image. Must be jpeg, png, gif, or webp.

go_fast.description: Run faster predictions with additional optimizations.

description.description: Text description of the input image. Use 'auto' for auto captioning.

output_quality.description: Quality when saving the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality. Not relevant for .png outputs.

disable_safety_checker.description: Disable safety checker for generated images.

image.description: Raster image to convert to SVG format. Supported formats: PNG, JPG, WEBP. Max 5MB, max 16MP, max dimension 4096px, min dimension 256px.

seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation

video.description: Input video to edit. Videos must be between 2 and 30 seconds and less than 16MB.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the edit to be applied to the input video.

keyframe_images.description: Up to 5 optional keyframe images used as more precise control over edits. The position of each keyframe is given by keyframe_positions.

keyframe_positions.description: Position of each keyframe in keyframe_images. One entry per image. Each value must be 'first', 'last', or a timestamp in seconds (e.g. '1.67').

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results. Leave blank for random seed.

steps.description: Number of diffusion steps (higher = better quality but slower)

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired audio

duration.description: Duration of generated audio in seconds

cfg_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale (higher = more prompt adherence)

seed.description: Random seed. Leave blank for random

image.description: Input image to generate video from.

last_image.description: Optional last image to condition the video generation. If provided, creates smoother transitions between frames.

num_frames.description: Number of video frames. 81 frames give the best results

resolution.description: Resolution of video. 16:9 corresponds to 832x480px, and 9:16 is 480x832px

frames_per_second.description: Frames per second. Note that the pricing of this model is based on the video duration at 16 fps

interpolate_output.description: Interpolate the generated video to 30 FPS using ffmpeg

disable_safety_checker.description: Disable safety checker for generated video.

lora_scale_transformer.description: Determines how strongly the transformer LoRA should be applied.

lora_scale_transformer_2.description: Determines how strongly the transformer_2 LoRA should be applied.

lora_weights_transformer.description: Load LoRA weights for the HIGH transformer. Supports arbitrary .safetensors URLs from the Internet (for example, 'https://huggingface.co/TheRaf7/instagirl-v2/resolve/main/Instagirlv2.0_hinoise.safetensors')

lora_weights_transformer_2.description: Load LoRA weights for the LOW transformer_2. Supports arbitrary .safetensors URLs from the Internet. Can be different from transformer LoRA. (for example, 'https://huggingface.co/TheRaf7/instagirl-v2/resolve/main/Instagirlv2.0_lownoise.safetensors')

seed.description: Random seed. Leave blank for random

num_frames.description: Number of video frames. 81 frames give the best results

resolution.description: Resolution of video. 16:9 corresponds to 832x480px, and 9:16 is 480x832px

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of video. 16:9 corresponds to 832x480px, and 9:16 is 480x832px

optimize_prompt.description: Translate prompt to Chinese before generation

frames_per_second.description: Frames per second. Note that the pricing of this model is based on the video duration at 16 fps

interpolate_output.description: Interpolate the generated video to 30 FPS using ffmpeg

disable_safety_checker.description: Disable safety checker for generated video.

lora_scale_transformer.description: Determines how strongly the transformer LoRA should be applied.

lora_scale_transformer_2.description: Determines how strongly the transformer_2 LoRA should be applied.

lora_weights_transformer.description: Load LoRA weights for transformer. Supports arbitrary .safetensors URLs from the Internet (for example, 'https://huggingface.co/Viktor1717/scandinavian-interior-style1/resolve/main/my_first_flux_lora_v1.safetensors')

lora_weights_transformer_2.description: Load LoRA weights for transformer_2. Supports arbitrary .safetensors URLs from the Internet. Can be different from transformer LoRA.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Range: 0-2147483647

prompt.description: Editing instructions or style transfer description

duration.description: Duration of the output video in seconds. If not set, matches input video duration. Use this to truncate.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output video. 'auto' uses the input video's aspect ratio.

audio_setting.description: Audio behavior for edited video. 'auto': model decides whether to regenerate audio. 'origin': keep the original audio.
